name: connector-conventions
description: Conventions for working through connectors — both the rules a connected store carries in its own content and the rules an agent should follow when using it. A skill per connector (Google Drive, where a CONVENTIONS document governs its own folder and everything beneath it; GitHub, whose MCP read path silently mangles issue and pull request text and whose write path corrupts a long URL), plus cross-cutting skills for rules that span sources.
